mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) consistently leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower discount rates increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 7.0% signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when UNRATE is below 7.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic expansion, which drives corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO and HOUST both rising fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 days as higher interest rates dampen economic activity and corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS is above 2.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) consistently indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS is rising (monthly change > 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the annual inflation rate above 2.5% signals potential monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5% annually over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate robust consumer demand and a tight labor market, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (as indicated by INDPRO growth above 2.0% annually), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 60 days due to overvaluation and the risk of policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when INDPRO growth is above 2.0% annually over any 3-year rolling window.
